events.title: Tupac Shakur: 30 Years Since His Death
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, influential rapper Tupac Shakur was tragically shot dead in Las Vegas. He would have been 55.

angles.name: Remembering Tupac
angles.copy: 30 years ago today, we lost a hip-hop icon. Tupac Shakur's music and legacy continue to resonate. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Jimi Hendrix: 56 Years Since His Death
events.blurb: Remembering guitar legend Jimi Hendrix, who passed away on this day in 1970. He would have been 84.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix's Legacy
angles.copy: 56 years since we lost a true pioneer. Jimi Hendrix's influence on rock music is immeasurable. What's your favourite Hendrix moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' Turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road's 57th
angles.copy: 57 years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover is still one of the most famous in music history. What's your go-to track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde Turns 75
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to The Pretenders' frontwoman, Chrissie Hynde, born in 1951.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the brilliant Chrissie Hynde! The Pretenders' iconic sound still rocks. What's your favourite Pretenders song?

events.title: Liam Gallagher Turns 54
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher, born in 1972.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the legendary Liam Gallagher! From Oasis to solo success, he's still got it. What's your favourite track?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Turns 55
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine's 55th
angles.copy: John Lennon's 'Imagine' turns 55 today. Its message of peace and unity is as powerful now as it was then. What does the song mean to you?

events.title: The iPod Turns 25
events.blurb: Apple introduced the revolutionary first-generation iPod on this day in 2001.

angles.name: 25 Years of iPod
angles.copy: Can you believe it's 25 years since the original iPod was unveiled? It completely changed how we listen to music. What was your first iPod?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day
events.blurb: Celebrate James Bond Day, marking the premiere of the first 007 film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: 007 Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Time to celebrate over 60 years of 007. Who's your favourite Bond, and what's the best theme song?

events.title: John Lennon Would Have Been 86
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we're remembering the profound impact of John Lennon. His music and message live on.

events.title: John Cleese Turns 87
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the iconic comedian and actor, John Cleese, born in 1939.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the comedy legend John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, he's given us so many laughs. What's your favourite moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Turns 58
angles.copy: 58 years ago, The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. A sprawling masterpiece that pushed boundaries. What are your standout tracks?

events.title: Freddie Mercury: 35 Years Since His Death
events.blurb: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991. He would have been 80.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: 35 years since we lost one of the greatest showmen of all time, Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen song?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Turns 61
angles.copy: 61 years of The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul'! This album was a real turning point for the band. What's your favourite track from it?

events.title: John Lennon: 46 Years Since His Death
events.blurb: Remembering the life and legacy of John Lennon, who was tragically killed on this day in 1980. He would have been 86.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: 46 years ago today, the world lost John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to inspire generations. What's his most impactful song for you?
